findings.evidence: The closure declarations at lines 176–218 contain no inverse, division, or general complex-scalar closure theorem.
findings.fix: Replace “all” with an explicit description of the operations actually supported.
findings.issue: The module docstring claims `RealOnImagAxis` is closed under “all” pointwise algebraic operations, but the file only supplies constants, negation, addition, subtraction, multiplication, real scalar multiplication, and natural powers.

findings.evidence: Lines 153–168 show the distinct hypotheses and theorem names.
findings.fix: Name `differentiableAt_resToImagAxis_of_mDiffAt` there, or describe the actual `DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z ↦ F (ofComplex z))` hypothesis.
findings.issue: The main-results entry says `differentiableAt_resToImagAxis` assumes manifold differentiability, but that theorem assumes ordinary real differentiability of `F ∘ ofComplex`; the manifold result is `differentiableAt_resToImagAxis_of_mDiffAt`.

summary: The analysis module docstring overstates one closure API and attributes the manifold-differentiability result to the wrong theorem.
